exclusions: All supplied sessionIds in v1 test and v2 reserved confirmation samples; reserve before new fitting or outcomes
training: Same 59,594 evaluable April training queries as v2; same 5,932 validation queries
models: causal item co-occurrence and prior user context plus LambdaMART
collaborative_cutoffs: Train Apr1-7: Mar30; Apr8-14: Apr6; Apr15-21: Apr13; Apr22-29: Apr20. Validation: Apr29. Confirmation: May14.
model_selection: Validation NDCG@10; test new feature models and simple validated score combinations; freeze before final sample
target: All original query candidates, same binary click target, same NDCG@10; no easier subset or sampled candidates
limitations: Third same-period sample, not independent temporal replication. Preserve and disclose every prior experiment.
selection_rule: Fresh same-date development query sample excluding original validation session IDs. Open once after candidate fitting; select highest mean NDCG and freeze before new confirmation.
